scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving shopping & payments
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Shopping and Payments
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: shopping & payments — a misunderstanding or problem involving shopping & payments
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving shopping & payments; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Mr David this is not what she ordered.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan báo cho anh David biết đây không phải món chị đặt.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, David. This is not what I ordered.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh David. Đây không phải món tôi đặt.

turns.speaker: Mr David
turns.english: Oh, I am sorry. Let me check.
turns.vietnamese: Ôi, tôi xin lỗi. Để tôi kiểm tra lại.

turns.speaker: Mr David
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi vì sự cố này.
